El fondo sugiere una pared mineral oscura con una transición suave hacia verde grisáceo, sin convertirse en un paisaje literal. La dualidad de la tierra húmeda y el aire luminoso: una corriente fresca de bergamota y jengibre atraviesa un paisaje táctil de vetiver, geranio e incienso ahumado.

fresco, aromático, masculino, elegante, terroso, cinematográfico, sofisticado, ligeramente misterioso

charcoal black, wet slate gray, deep vetiver green, muted sage, pale bergamot yellow, restrained geranium pink-red, warm amber, smoke ivory

dark wet volcanic stone, transparent glass, natural vetiver roots, green geranium leaves, pink-red geranium petals, rough bergamot peel, fresh ginger rhizome, amber incense resin, thin translucent smoke

- Typography must never cover the bottle and must remain legible.

Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.

50mm lens, medium shallow depth of field, focus on the perfume bottle, horizontal composition, 5:4 aspect ratio.

extreme photorealism. photorealistic materials, realistic lighting, realistic shadows, realistic reflections, realistic glass, realistic botanical textures, realistic physical proportions, realistic atmospheric effects, no illustration, no cartoon, no obvious CGI, no generic stock photography.
